text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — KiteWorks wants to kick off a 3-week POC next month. Need to align scope, success criteria, and security asks before we send the SOW. They care a lot about data residency (EU), DPA, SOC2 artifacts, and a pen-test window.
Priya Nair: Thanks Alex. Quick Q — will KiteWorks route live PHI through our hosted API or do they require Private/VPC or on-prem?
Alex Chen: They said some customers are HIPAA-regulated, so they prefer Private (VPC) for the production rollout but are OK with hosted for the POC if we can ensure no customer data is ingested and logs are retained in EU.
Daniel Ortiz: For POC, we usually recommend synthetic or redacted datasets. If they insist on real PHI, we should push for Private or Dedicated with customer-managed keys.
Marie Gomez: @Alex can you get clarity on whether the POC needs encryption-at-rest using their KMS? That affects deployment type and timeline.
Alex Chen: I'll confirm. KiteWorks legal also requested SOC2 type II report, evidence of encryption, and a signed DPA. They want to see our pen-test policy and whether we allow customer-led pen tests.
Jamie Li (CSE): For success criteria, propose this baseline: 1) functional — 95% intent accuracy on a 200-sample prompt set; 2) latency — p95 < 300ms for chatted flows; 3) stability — zero infra incidents during the demo week; 4) cost — estimated tokens/unit within agreed budget. Is that realistic?
Daniel Ortiz: Accuracy target is fine but define metric (F1, exact-match, or human eval). I'd prefer a blended eval: automated metric + 20 human spot checks for hallucination.
Priya Nair: Timeline: week 0 provision, week 1 ingest prompts/eval harness, week 2 fine-tune prompts/rollout canary, week 3 demo + wrap. Need DPA + SOC2 in week 0 or they won't sign the temporary access form.
Alex Chen: Pricing ask from KiteWorks: an estimate for a 3-week POC using Hosted API with modest traffic (peak 50 qps) vs Dedicated reserved slot. They want a ballpark per-token and a POC discount.
Marie Gomez: For 50 qps we should show both: Hosted estimated spend and Dedicated monthly pro-rate. Also call out that Hosted may have EU residency constraints; Dedicated in AWS eu-west-1 would be the safer bet.
Jamie Li (CSE): Operational blockers: 1) VPC peering or private link for secure ingestion; 2) audit log export to their SIEM; 3) KMS integration or customer-provided CMK for HSM. Which of these can we meet for a short POC?
sec-bot: Reminder — SOC2 artifacts available: cert_summary.pdf and SOC2_coverage_matrix.xlsx. DPA template v1.4 is stored in Drive: https://drive.redwood/dpa-templates. Pen-test policy: we require a scope addendum + 72hr notice and a temporary read-only role for testers.
Daniel Ortiz: Good — send those links to their security team. For pen-tests, we allow them but need to review testcases if they might target production infra. POC instances can be isolated in a dedicated VPC.
Alex Chen: KiteWorks also asked about GDPR: data subject deletion, data export, and whether logs carry PII. We should confirm retention windows and anonymization options for request logs.
Jamie Li (CSE): We can anonymize logs and set a 30-day retention for the POC. For deletion requests, we can run a purge job during POC closeout. Note: if they edge-case export EU-only storage, we need to route to eu-west-1.
Priya Nair: Action items: Alex — confirm PHI usage and KMS requirement; Alex — share DPA & SOC2 artifacts by EOD Tue; Jamie — draft eval harness and sample prompt set; Marie — prepare pricing sketch for Hosted vs Dedicated (3-week pro-rate + optional Dedicated commit); Daniel — confirm pen-test rules and temporary VPC isolation steps.
Alex Chen: I'll get those items and aim to have the legal/security packet out by Tuesday. Also proposing a kickoff with KiteWorks security and our sec lead on Wed.
Daniel Ortiz: For the eval harness, suggested command snippet we use for batch runs: ```python
# run eval
from rdw_eval import Runner
r = Runner(model='redwood-13b-dedicated', region='eu-west-1')
r.run_batch('kite_prompts.json', out='kite_results.json')
```
Jamie Li (CSE): Perfect — include expected metrics in the harness: latency p50/p95, token usage, model score, hallucination flag. We'll provide a template CSV for results.
Marie Gomez: Pricing note — POC discount for Sales-led POCs is typically 40% off hosted list or 20% pro-rate off Dedicated monthly. I'll model both and show cost delta.
Priya Nair: Don't forget to document acceptance criteria for data handling: PII redaction required for hosted; Private option requires signed DPA + KMS agreement.
Alex Chen: Final ask from KiteWorks: can we do a quick security Q&A doc for their infosec with our answers inline? I'll draft and loop in sec.
sec-bot: FYI — compliance artifacts email template: subject: "Redwood compliance artifacts for POC". Attach: SOC2_summary.pdf, DPA_template.docx, PenTestProcess.pdf, DataFlow-EU.pdf.
Alex Chen: Great — I'll assemble and send. Thanks everyone, will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
